chapter: Buddy Petit's switch, death and family
title: Buddy Petit switches him from drums to alto sax
summary: Foster took lessons from Lorenzo Tio and David Jones, then Buddy Petit moved him from drums to alto and put Abbie Foster on drums for fairs.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Too bad we didn't bring the copies. I got the… Speaking of Buddy Petit, I believe Harold told us that he had you to change over to… Yeah, I played with him. Another instrument. And then I…
Keep me up shaggy for him. Well, then I take a few lessons from Loretta Teo and he went to New York. You remember when he went to New York. What kind of a sax, what sax was it?

I think of alto with him. He was playing alto, right? Teo was playing tenor and alto. Tenor and alto, yeah. Mostly tenor. Mostly tenor. Yeah. Well, he was in St. Louis long after I got to… You know, taking notes with him. Did you ever play clarinet? No, I didn't. Just the alto set. Just the alto. And I take him from David Jones. David Jones. But he went to Texas. And well, that's when Buddy changed me over. He came. I was in the right neighborhood right around the corner. He came one day and I was rehearsing at home. I don't know what's the music, you know. And he came from drums to alto with him. And then we played those fairs. All those fairs were there. Covington. Bogusie. The Franklin Fair. Which drummer did he take on?
He took on Abbie Foster. Chinese.
Oh yeah. He was over to see us yesterday. Yeah. I suppose there's no relation is there? Huh? Is he related?
No related to me at all. Not at all. He put him on, taking him over on drums.
